token_set.name: Hometown History: Detroit Red Wings
token_set.description: Introducing Hometown History: Detroit Red Wings, a compilation of highlights commemorating historical moments celebrated by the Red Wings during the 2024-25 season. These collectibles not only honor the rich history of the team but also rewind the clock to capture the players and achievements that solidify the franchise in the hearts of fans, and within the pages of NHL history.

description:
In his final season with the Detroit Red Wings, 22-season team captain Steve Yzerman delivered a memorable moment at Joe Louis Arena on March 31, 2006. Capitalizing on a play he disrupted at the blue line that led to a Chicago turnover, Yzerman found himself in the slot and hammered home a pass for his 691st career goal. This goal moved him past Mario Lemieux on the all-time goal-scoring list, placing him 8th at the time. Adding to an already legendary career, Yzerman’s accolades include three Stanley Cup championships, a Conn Smythe Trophy, a Frank J. Selke Trophy, and induction into the Hockey Hall of Fame.
